outcome.technical: Added plugins/audit/scripts/governance/run-agent-session.py (entry point, PATH_PREAMBLE, safe_stdio first in __main__, attach_usage_hint). session_argv() builds: -p --model <full id> --effort <e> --permission-mode auto --output-format stream-json --verbose --max-budget-usd <b> --plugin-dir <_output.PLUGIN_ROOT>; reviewer adds --agents <file> --agent audit-reviewer, the file built from agents/audit-reviewer.md through _help.front_matter (body = prompt, description, tools); --resume appends one pair. A model id not matching FULL_MODEL_ID (an alias) is exit 2 before claude starts; a blank --resume is exit 2. Prompt read from the script's stdin or --prompt-file and written to claude's stdin, never argv. Child started with _proc_group.group_kwargs() (own group), cwd = --tree, TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP = a mkdtemp under --scratch, interrupt pair armed and the group torn down on SIGINT/SIGTERM. Stream saved to <state-dir>/sessions/<task>.<role>.<utc>.<pid>.jsonl with .stderr (and .agents.json for the reviewer) beside it. Prints one line 'session=<id> total_cost_usd=<cost> exit=<claude exit> stream=<path>' from the LAST result event; no result event, or a result missing session_id or a numeric total_cost_usd, prints 'could-not-run: ... stream <path> ...' and exits 3. Exit 0 result + claude 0, 1 result + claude non-zero. tools/lints/_deps.py: run-agent-session placed in the entry-point layer beside stamp-verification, with its edges named; PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: tree line, a section, and the module map regenerated by `python3 tools/lints/_deps.py --write-map` (exit 0; adds 'run-agent-session -> _claude_home, _help, _output, _proc_group'). tests/test_run_agent_session.py: 19 cases (ras0-ras18) against a stub claude on PATH (sh wrapper on POSIX, .cmd on Windows), the script run as a subprocess. Before implementing: `python3 tests/test_run_agent_session.py --selftest` exit 1, 'FAIL ras0 the script exists ...', 0/1. After: exit 0, ALL PASS 19/19. Mutation probe over a scratch copy (pycache purged per cycle, restore verified True): group_kwargs dropped -> ras10 red; first result read -> ras6, ras16; prompt appended to argv -> ras5, ras13; --agent on the writer -> ras4; resume drops a flag -> ras17; no-result returns cost 0 -> ras15; alias accepted -> ras18; TMPDIR not set -> ras9; --verbose dropped -> ras2; exit always 0 -> ras16. A mutation that only moved the --resume pair to the front survived ras17, by design: the clause is that nothing ELSE changes, and position is not asserted. External probes (claude 2.1.305, 2026-10-21): `echo hi | claude -p --output-format stream-json --model no-such-model-probe` -> 'Error: When using --print, --output-format=stream-json requires --verbose', exit 1; a live reviewer run of this script with model claude-nosuch-9 (no billable call: total_cost_usd 0) showed the real CLI accepting --agents <file> + --agent audit-reviewer (init.agents lists 'audit-reviewer'), --plugin-dir loading this tree's plugin as audit@inline, permissionMode auto, and the script printing 'session=ed8af8a0-... total_cost_usd=0 exit=1 stream=...', exit 1. Beyond own-tests, run ad hoc for lint safety: in the tree, test__deps 254/254, test__output_lints 166/166 (first run red on two of my own lines - no attach_usage_hint, open() without newline - both fixed), test__output 84/84, test__refs 289/289, ruff clean, vermin clean. Because ls-files-scoped lints cannot see untracked files, the tree was also copied into a throwaway git repo in the scratchpad and committed there: tools/sweep-selftests.py 189/191 files ok; the two red ones (tools/check-example-ledgers.py el1, tools/measure-context.py mc18) fail because that one-commit repo cannot resolve historical commits ('which this repository cannot resolve' / 'ref 7b489337c06d does not resolve'), not on any file of this task; test__output_lints, test__deps and the own suite re-run there on the final bytes: all pass. plugins/audit/reference/orchestrator.md is in files but the description asks nothing of it; left untouched. Acceptance (8), live cost equal to a transcript re-price, is the confirming run's, not this suite's. The two edits to _deps.py's layer comment and the script's imports were made through Bash (a sed and a python replace) rather than Edit; no tool refused, and both files are in this task's files.
outcome.descriptive: A writer or reviewer can now be run as a headless claude -p session under a per-session budget, with its cost printed from the session's own result event.
